references.text: Moses describes the same event where he was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water
Moses repeats that he fell down before the Lord's presence for forty days and forty nights without eating or drinking
Refers to the ten words (commandments) that were written on the tablets
Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights during the first time he received the tablets
God gave Moses the two tablets of testimony, stone tablets written with God's finger
Elijah also went forty days and forty nights to God's mountain Horeb in God's power
Jesus fasted for forty days and forty nights in the wilderness, parallel to Moses' fast
The Lord proclaimed his covenant, the ten words, and wrote them on two stone tablets
Direct narrative continuation: Confirmation that the tablets were given after the 40 days and nights.
